raw_contexts.title: Hyrbyair Marri
raw_contexts.paragraph_text: Hyrbyair Marri (Urdu: ‎ ) (born 1968) is a Baloch nationalist from Balochistan. He is the fifth son of the nationalist leader Khair Bakhsh Marri. Hyrbyair Marri lives in Britain.

raw_contexts.title: From Father to Son
raw_contexts.paragraph_text: From Father to Son (Finnish: Isästä poikaan ) is a 1942 novel by the Finnish writer Mika Waltari.

raw_contexts.title: Atta Muhammad Marri
raw_contexts.paragraph_text: Atta Muammad Marri (1937–1998) was a Sindhi politician hailing from a political agricultural family of Sindh. His father Ali Muhammad Marri was an influential politician of his time and remained member of the Legislative Assembly during the British Raj, as well as the Sindh President of the Khilafat Movement.

raw_contexts.title: Ghazan Marri
raw_contexts.paragraph_text: Ghazan Marri (Urdu: مير غزن مری‎ ) is a politician from Balochistan, Pakistan. Marri is the son of politician Nawab Khair Bakhsh Marri. Marri's late brother, Balach Marri, was also a politician.

raw_contexts.title: Putative father
raw_contexts.paragraph_text: A putative father, with some variations in specific language, generally means a man whose legal relationship to a child has not been established but who is alleged to be or claims that he may be the biological father of a child who is born to a woman to whom he is not married at the time of the child's birth.

raw_contexts.title: Marri Nallos
raw_contexts.paragraph_text: Marri Nallos is a pop singer from the Philippines.

raw_contexts.title: Margret Marri
raw_contexts.paragraph_text: Margret Marri is a footballer from Burma who currently plays as a forward.

raw_contexts.title: Father, Dear Father
raw_contexts.paragraph_text: Father, Dear Father is a British television sitcom produced by Thames Television for ITV from 1968 to 1973 starring Patrick Cargill. It was subsequently made into a spin-off film of the same title released in 1973.
